name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the first sentence is a next-step rule, correctly ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box); the second makes the box at the exit a condition of reaching it, correctly Response(at_exit, holding_box) with no Existence(at_exit). The rule-only warning is valid since both are rules, not unconditional goals.

texts: Whenever the box falls, the agent must be holding the box again on the very next step.
If the agent reaches the exit, the agent must have the box in its hands at that moment.
